blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Natural-language instructions often rely on high-level abstractions, such as asking an agent to ``stack blocks in a pyramid.'' Interpreting abstract instructions requires models to both identify the abstraction intended by the speaker, and unroll it into the many concrete actions that instantiate it. Language models struggle here: prior work has shown that performance degrades as the level of abstraction in the instruction rises. To bridge the gap between natural language abstraction and concrete actions, we propose to borrow from coding environments the notion of a {\em domain-specific language} (DSL), an explicit representation layer whose documented primitives name recurring abstractions that expand into concrete actions. We demonstrate the efficacy of DSLs for NL interpretation on \textsc{Hexagons}, a visually-grounded instruction-following task graded for abstraction. We further ask whether language models can induce such DSLs themselves from domain data. Our results show that while code generation consistently improves over direct inference, code generation over a human-curated DSL yields dramatic gains, up to 10 absolute F1 points, reaching the human skyline, with gains concentrated at {\em higher} abstraction levels. We confirm this pattern on the \textsc{Text2CAD} benchmark. At the same time, model-induced DSLs recover only part of this gain, remaining inconsistent across runs and short of their human-curated counterpart. Overall, the right representation closes much of the gap caused by high abstraction --- but inducing that layer of representation automatically is where models still fall short, and where we see a strong opportunity for the community to make progress.
blocks.zh: 自然语言的指令常常依赖于高层次的抽象,例如要求代理商"在金字塔中堆积块". 解释抽象指示需要模型既能识别演讲者意图的抽象,又能将它解入许多使它迅速化的具体行动中. 语言模型在这里挣扎:前作表明,随着指令中抽象程度的提高,性能会退化. 为了弥合自然语言抽象化与具体行动之间的差距,我们提议从编码环境中借用一个`em域特定语言'的概念(DSL),一个明确的表述层,其文献记载的原始人称反复出现的抽象化为具体行动. 我们在\ textsc{六边形} 上演示了 DSLs 对 NL 解释的功效。 这是一个可视化的指令, 用于抽象化 。 我们还询问语言模型能否从域数据中诱导这些DSL本身. 我们的结果显示,虽然代码生成在直接推论上不断改进,但代码生成在人验证的DSL上产生巨大的收益,最高达到10个绝对的F1点,达到人类的天际线,收益集中于~em更高~抽象水平. 我们在\ textsc{ Text2CAD} 基准上确认这个模式 。 同时,模型引发的DSL只恢复了这一收益的一部分,仍然前后不一致,与经人验证的对应物相差甚远. 总的来说,正确的代表性弥补了高度抽象造成的大部分差距 -- -- 但诱导这种层层的代表性是模式仍然不足的地方,我们看到社区有很强的机会取得进展。

(b) HexaGen makes task-relevant abstractions explicit, letting the model generate code that executes to the correct output.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 抽象指示压缩许多低级绘图动作在棋盘上. (a) 直接预测必须直接恢复这一结构,以端-端方式进行。 (b) HexaGen使与任务有关的抽象内容明确,使模型生成执行的代码能够正确输出。

blocks.en:
Language models are increasingly deployed as agents that must act on natural-language instructions: editing, drawing, operating software, manipulating an environment, and a lot more. However,
the instructions users write are rarely explicit sequences of actions. A user asking an agent to “add a ‘total’ row to each table in the report” expects it to recover the many concrete edits compressed into this phrase, rather than be instructed for each one.
blocks.zh:
语言模型被越来越多地部署为必须执行自然语言指令的代理:编辑,绘图,操作软件,操纵环境,以及更多. 不过
用户写的指示很少是明确的动作序列。 一个用户要求代理人在报告的每一表中 " 添加一个`总 ' 一行 " ,希望它能够收回压缩成这个短语的许多具体编辑,而不是被指示每个短语。

blocks.en: This tendency for compression is unsurprising: human speakers typically provide the minimal amount of information that is needed for a successful interpretation ( Grice, 1975 ) . Speakers thus convey multiple actions through abstraction , defined by Wing (2010) as “the representation of many instances through a single higher-level object, capturing essential structure while suppressing lower-level details.”
blocks.zh: 这种压缩的趋势是不足为奇的:讲人通常能提供成功解释所需的最低限度的信息(Grice,1975年)。 因此,发言者通过抽象表达多种行动,Wing(2010年)将其定义为“通过一个单一的更高层次的对象代表许多实例,捕捉基本结构,同时压制较低层次的细节。 “

blocks.en: For a language model to carry out abstract instructions, it must identify the abstract concepts and reconstruct the sequence of actions they leave implicit ( MacMahon et al., 2006 ; Artzi and Zettlemoyer, 2013 ) . Models are unevenly good at this: performance declines as instructions grow more abstract ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ; Ruis et al., 2020 ; Wu et al., 2021 ; Ahn et al., 2022 ) , particularly evident in Hexagons ( Lachmy et al., 2022 ) , where instructions are annotated with abstraction levels.
blocks.zh: 语言模型要执行抽象指示,就必须识别抽象概念,并重建它们留下的隐含动作序列(MacMahon等人,2006年;Artzi和Zettlemoyer,2013年)。 模型在这方面表现不均匀:随着指示的逐渐抽象化,性能下降(Shridhar等人,2020年;Ruis等人,2020年;Wu等人,2021年;Ahn等人,2022年),特别在Sixagons(Lachmy等人,2022年)中表现出来,指示用抽象水平来注释.

blocks.en:
This suggests a simple hypothesis: if the gap between language and action arises because abstract instructions leave task-relevant steps implicit, then unfolding those abstractions explicitly should help bridge it.
Code generation is a natural first step to explore ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Liang et al., 2022 ) : programming languages provide built-in mechanisms for unfolding abstraction — variables, loops, functions, conditions — so mapping instructions to code gives the model computational structure that exposes the structures implicit in language.
blocks.zh:
这表明一个简单的假设:如果由于抽象指示留下与任务相关的步骤而产生语言与行动之间的差距,那么这些抽象的出现应有助于弥补这种差距。
代码生成是自然探索的第一步(Chen et al., 2021; Liang et al., 2022) :编程语言为演化抽象提供了内置机制——变量,循环,功能,条件——所以代码的映射指令给出了揭示语言中隐含的结构的模型计算结构.

blocks.en: However, general-purpose code may not suffice: the model may still need to recover task-specific abstractions from scratch, e.g., what counts as a “table” or a “header” in a document, and reflect them as concrete operations.
blocks.zh: 然而,一般用途代码可能是不够的:该模型可能仍需要从零开始收回特定任务抽象,例如,在文件中什么是“表格”或“标题”,并将其反映为具体行动。

blocks.en:
In business environments, such recurring domain concepts are often provided as reusable operations through a domain-specific language (DSL) ( Mernik et al., 2005 ) that is then used in code to map abstraction to action.
In this work we ask: (i) can language models use task-specific DSLs to effectively follow natural language instructions? and, moreover, (ii) may language models come up with such DSLs themselves?
blocks.zh:
在商业环境中,这种反复出现的域名概念往往通过一个域名特定语言(DSL)(Mernik等人,2005年)作为可重复使用的操作提供,然后在代码中用于将抽象化映射为行动.
在这部作品中,我们询问: (一)语言模型能否使用特定任务DSL来有效遵循自然语言指令? 此外,(二) 语言模型本身能否提出这种DSL?

blocks.en: Our primary empirical investigation focuses on Hexagons , a visually grounded instruction-following benchmark designed to elicit abstraction in natural language. Its instructions refer to higher-level structures: complex objects, patterns, arrangements; and successful execution depends on producing the right low-level actions (Figure 2 ). Furthermore, Hexagons ’s abstraction-level annotation lets us control performance on abstraction, and isolate where the interpretation breaks down.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要经验调查集中在“六边形”上,这是一个有目视依据的、以自然语言引领抽象的教学基准。 它的指令指的是更高层次的结构:复杂的对象,模式,安排;成功执行取决于产生正确的低层次动作(图2 ). 此外,六角星的抽象级注释让我们能够控制抽象上的性能,并在解释破裂的地方孤立。

blocks.en:
We investigate the first question via a three-way comparison of strategies to solve the Hexagons board: direct inference, unrestricted Python generation, and Python generation over a DSL. In particular, we assess performance given HexaGen , a human-authored Python DSL we designed for this purpose, which defines decomposable abstractions on top of the Hexagon tiles: named shapes, spatial queries and geometric transformations.
The model may write an ordinary Python program and invoke DSL functions as needed, retaining full interpretive responsibility while offloading low-level domain-specific reasoning to the DSL (Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh:
我们通过对解决六角星板的策略的三维比较来调查第一个问题:直接推论,不受限制的Python生成,以及Python生成在DSL之上. 特别是,我们评估了我们为此设计的由人类授权的Python DSL的性能,它定义了可分解的六角瓷砖上方的抽象:命名形状、空间查询和几何转换。
该模型可能写一个普通的Python程序,并按需要引用DSL函数,同时将低级域特异性推理卸载到DSL(图1)时保留全部解释责任.

blocks.en:
Our results show that a human-curated DSL indeed leads to substantial performance gains, closing much of the gap with the human skyline, an effect we show on both Hexagon (Section 5 )
and a Text2CAD real-world scenario (Section 6 ).
This success
begs our second question, namely, can LLMs induce such DSLs themselves?
blocks.zh:
我们的结果显示,经过人验证的DSL确实能够带来巨大的性能收益,缩小了与人类天际线的大部分差距,这是我们对Hixagon(第5节)的影响。
和Text2CAD现实世界情景(第6节)。
这一成功
问我们第二个问题,即LLMs本身能否诱导这种DSL?

blocks.en: We investigate this by augmenting the Hexagons task training data, instructions paired with the denotations on the board, with a minimal API covering only low-level drawing actions. Models are asked to identify recurring patterns and implement respective DSL functions, producing executable Python code and documentation for downstream use. Replacing HexaGen with such induced DSLs shows mixed results relative to a minimal-API baseline, with improvements varying across models, but consistently underperforming the human-curated DSL counterpart.
blocks.zh: 我们通过增加六角星任务训练数据来调查这个问题, 指示与板上的注释相配, 最小的API只涵盖低级绘图动作。 模型被要求识别反复出现的模式,并执行各自的DSL功能,生成可执行的Python代码和文档,供下游使用. 用这种诱导的DSL取代HexaGen,与最低API基线相比,结果好坏参半,各模型的改进情况各不相同,但人类测算的DSL对应物的表现始终不佳。

blocks.en:
Taken together, our experiments show that interpreting and executing natural language instruction using a curated DSL consistently outperforms both direct inference and unrestricted code generation, with the largest gains where interpretation is hardest: at higher abstraction levels.
At the same time, we demonstrate that current LLMs fall short of human experts on the task of reliably inducing such abstraction layers themselves from natural language domain-specific data — leaving the automatic discovery of task-relevant abstraction layers from natural language texts as an open challenge for further investigation.
blocks.zh:
总而言之,我们的实验表明,使用一种经过曲解的DSL来解释和执行自然语言教学,其效果始终高于直接推论和不受限制的代码生成,在解释最困难的地方,其收益最大:在更高的抽象水平。
与此同时,我们表明,在可靠地从自然语言域特定数据中引出这种抽象层的任务方面,目前的LLMS还远远不能满足人类专家的要求——将自然语言文本中与任务相关的抽象层自动发现作为进一步调查的公开挑战.

blocks.en: 2 From Abstraction to Action:
blocks.zh: 2 从抽象到行动:

blocks.en: 2.1 Challenge and Key Hypotheses
blocks.zh: 2.1 挑战和关键假设

blocks.en: Interpreting and grounding abstract instructions poses a genuine challenge for LLMs, as it requires mapping natural-language abstractions to their underlying implicit and concrete actions to execute. Here we argue that tackling this challenge is inherently multifaceted.
blocks.zh: 抽象指示的解释和基础对法学硕士提出了真正的挑战,因为它要求绘制自然语言抽象的图示,以说明执行这些抽象指示所依据的隐含和具体行动。 我们在此认为,应对这一挑战必然是多方面的。

blocks.en: First we observe that formal coding languages are a natural, unambiguous way to express abstractions and how they unfold. Providing the model access to explicit computation — variables, loops, functions — alongside the language utterances, may help recover the actions that natural language leaves implicit. We therefore hypothesize that mapping instructions to executable code (rather than, e.g., relying on thinking trajectories) is a better strategy than direct inference on the task at hand.
blocks.zh: 首先,我们观察到,正式的编码语言是一种自然的,毫不含糊的方式来表达抽象及其如何展开. 提供模式获取明确的计算——变量,环路,函数——与语言的语句一起,可能有助于恢复自然语言所隐含的动作. 因此,我们假设,可执行代码的绘图指示(而不是依赖思维轨迹)比直接推断手头的任务要好。

blocks.en: Following this intuition, we cast instruction-following as a program-synthesis problem over a grounding environment: given a natural-language instruction x x and an initial state s 0 s_{0} , the model must produce a program p p whose execution yields the target state s ∗ s^{*} .
blocks.zh: 根据这种直觉,我们把以下指令作为程序合成问题放在地面环境上:给一个自然语言指令xx和初始状态为0 s_{0},该模型必须产生一个程序p,其执行能产生目标状态s * s^{*} 。

blocks.en:
Yet, code generation in a general-purpose language does not fully close the abstraction gap for a specific task.
Plain Python lacks task-specific notions, (in Hexagons (§ 2.2 ), for example, these may be hexagonal grids, spatial neighbors, or geometric objects,) forcing the model to learn and implement every domain concept from scratch.
Generally,
we argue that code generation alone may not suffice for many real-world tasks, whose relevant abstractions are often domain-specific and lack, or are divorced from, their interpretation in a general-purpose language. So, just as SQL encapsulates relational operations like joins and aggregations rather than requiring repetitive iterations, a domain-specific language (DSL) can encapsulate recurring domain concepts as reusable operations ( Mernik et al., 2005 ) .
blocks.zh:
然而,通用语言的代码生成并不能完全弥合特定任务的抽象差距.
Plain Python缺乏任务特定的概念,(例如,在Hexagons(§ 2.2)中,这些概念可能是六边形网格,空间邻接,或几何对象,)迫使模型从头开始学习和执行每一个域概念.
一般来说,
我们主张,单是代码生成可能不足以完成许多现实世界的任务,这些任务的相关抽象常常是专有领域,缺乏或脱离了对通用语言的解释. 因此,正如SQL封装连接和聚合等关系操作而不是要求重复迭代一样,特定域语言(DSL)可以封装重复出现的域概念作为可重复使用操作(Mernik等人,2005年).

blocks.en:
We draw from this a key conclusion:
while code generation provides the machinery of computation, what is still missing is a way to encapsulate recurring domain concepts as reusable operations that the model can compose and reuse rather than re-derive. For this, a DSL can help.
blocks.zh:
我们从中得出一个关键结论:
虽然代码生成提供了计算机器,但仍然缺少一种将反复出现的域概念封装为可重复使用的操作的方法,该模型可以编译和再利用,而不是再开发. 对于这个,DSL可以有所帮助.

blocks.en: 2.2 The Hexagons benchmark
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 六边形基准

blocks.en: The Hexagons benchmark ( Lachmy et al., 2022 ) is an instruction-following benchmark designed to elicit abstraction in natural language, derived from a collaborative drawing game in which one player describes how to recreate an image on a hexagonal grid while the other follows the instructions on an empty board. Since players are rewarded for both accuracy and speed, speakers naturally resort to compressed, abstract descriptions characteristic of natural communication — referring to objects, loops, spatial transformations, and conditions — each standing for many low-level actions, with missing details left to be filled by the hearer.
blocks.zh: 六角星基准(Lachmy et al., 2022年)是一个指令跟随基准,旨在在自然语言中引领抽象,它来源于一个合作绘画游戏,其中一位玩家描述了如何在六角星格上重现一个图像,而另一位则遵循一个空板上的指示. 由于玩家在准确性和速度上都得到奖励,所以演讲者自然会诉诸于自然交流的压缩,抽象描述特征——指物体,环路,空间变换,以及条件——每个角色都站在许多低级动作上,缺少细节留待听者填充.

blocks.en: The core challenge in solving the Hexagons task is that carrying out such instructions requires more than understanding explicit content: the model must identify the abstract constructions in the instruction, ground them in exact tile coordinates, and execute the implied actions correctly. As illustrated in Figure 2 , “a blue flower” compresses a spatial arrangement of seven tiles into a single reference, while “on each of the outermost corners” implicitly specifies four locations dependent on the geometry of the previously constructed object. These stages are tightly coupled — errors in interpretation propagate through grounding into execution — and each grows harder as abstraction increases, as confirmed empirically by Lachmy et al. (2022) . Hexagons therefore provides a controlled testbed for studying how to improve the interpretation , grounding , and execution of abstract instructions in contemporary LLMs.
blocks.zh: 解决六边形任务的核心挑战是,执行这种指示需要的不仅仅是理解明确的内容:模型必须确定指示中的抽象构思,将其置于精确的瓷砖坐标中,并正确执行隐含的行动. 如图2所示,“一朵蓝花”将七块瓷砖的空间安排压缩成单一的参照物,而“在最外角上”则隐含地规定了四个位置,这四个位置取决于先前构造的物体的几何特征。 这些阶段是紧密结合的——在解释中的错误通过执行而传播——随着抽象化的增加,每个阶段都变得更加困难,Lachmy等人(2022年)的经验证实了这一点。 因此,六边形为研究如何改进当代LLMs中抽象指令的解释、定位和执行提供了一个有控制的试验台。

blocks.en: 3 DSLs for Natural Language Abstraction
blocks.zh: 3 DSL 自然语言抽象

blocks.en: 3.1 From General Code to Task-Specific Libraries
blocks.zh: 3.1 从一般代码到特定任务图书馆

blocks.en:
The notion of a domain-specific language (DSL) is known from coding environments, and it refers to a specialized library tailored to a particular application domain, for defining, breaking down and spelling out domain-specific abstract notions ( Mernik et al., 2005 ) .
By raising the level of abstraction to match the problem at hand, DSLs reduce both the effort and the error rate of programming within their target domain.
In our setting, we aim to use DSLs for interpreting naturally occurring language instructions in different domains, likewise reducing the effort and errors in interpreting and following natural language instructions.
blocks.zh:
特定域语言(DSL)的概念从编码环境而知,它指的是针对特定应用域量身定制的专门库,用于定义,细分和拼写特定域的抽象概念(Mernik et al.,2005.).
通过提高抽象度以匹配手头的问题,DSLs降低了其目标域内编程的努力和错误率.
在我们的环境下,我们的目标是使用DSLs来解释不同领域自然发生的语言指令,同样减少解释和遵循自然语言指令的努力和错误.

blocks.en: On the way to obtain this, we face several concerns in the design of DSLs for NL. The first is representation : the DSL should provide first-class constructs for the abstractions that genuinely organize solutions in the target domain. The second is transparency : because our DSL is to be consumed by a language model, what each primitive does and how it should be called must be clearly evident from its name, signature, and documentation ( Qu et al., 2025 ) . The third is robustness : constrained semantics, safe defaults, and failure-resistant interfaces should ensure that when a program fails, it fails because the intended construction is wrong, not because the programming interface is fragile.
blocks.zh: 在获得这个机会的路上,我们在为NL设计DSL时面临着几个问题. 第一是代表性:DSL应为真正在目标领域组织解决方案的抽象内容提供一流的构造. 第二个是透明度:因为我们的DSL将被一种语言模型所消耗,每个原始人做什么以及如何称呼它必须从其名称、签名和文档中清楚地看出(Qu等人,2025年)。 第三个是稳健性 : 受限语义,安全默认,和耐故障接口应确保当一个程序失败时,由于预期的构造错误而失败,而不是因为编程接口脆弱.

blocks.en:
We apply these principles to Hexagons to deliver HexaGen , an expert-curated Python DSL that supplies the missing abstraction layer for following instrucions on the Hexagons board. On the representational side, we identified its core primitives by manually analyzing training examples, guided by the abstraction categories in Lachmy et al. (2022) . For transparency , the API exposes non-overlapping, self-explanatory methods with thorough documentation. For robustness , it validates inputs eagerly, provides safe defaults, and raises descriptive exceptions for common pitfalls, thus errors reflect flawed usage, not interface fragility.
The full DSL specification, including all constructors, actions, queries, and their signatures, is provided in in Appendix E . A representative example is given in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh:
我们把这些原则应用到六角星上,以交付六角星,一种经过专家验证的Python DSL,提供缺失的抽象层,用于跟踪六角星板上的指令. 在代表性方面,我们以Lachmy等人(2022年)的抽象类别为指导,通过人工分析培训实例,确定了其核心原始物。 为了透明起见,API将非重叠的、不言自明的方法与详尽的文件公之于众。 对于稳健性,它急切地验证输入,提供安全的默认,并提出常见陷阱的描述性例外,因此错误反映了错误的使用,而不是界面的脆弱性.
完整的DSL规格,包括所有构造器、动作、查询及其签名载于附录E。 图1提供了一个有代表性的例子。

blocks.en: 3.2 Inducing DSLs from Data
blocks.zh: 3.2 从数据诱导DSL

blocks.en: Creating useful and adeqaute DSLs, such as HexaGen , is a human-intensive and costly engineering effort. The theoretical benefits of DSLs in general, and of HexaGen in particular, beg a natural follow-up question: can LLMs induce such abstraction layers themselves, given only examples of the task?
blocks.zh: 创造有用和实用的DSL,如HexaGen,是一项人力密集和昂贵的工程工作。 通常DSLs的理论好处,特别是HexoGen的理论好处,引出了一个自然的后续问题:仅举任务的例子,LLMS本身能否诱导这种抽象层?

blocks.en:
We formulate this problem as follows. Let 𝒜 0 \mathcal{A}_{0} denote a foundation library exposing only the task-specific primitives.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: Goal. We set out to empirically investigate two questions: whether a task-aligned DSLs improve LLM performance over plain code generation, and whether LLMs can induce useful DSLs themselves.
blocks.zh: 进球了 我们开始以实证方式调查两个问题:一个任务相匹配的DSL是否比普通代码生成提高了LLM性能,以及LLMS能否自己诱导有用的DSL.

blocks.en: Data. We use the original Hexagons dataset Lachmy et al. (2022) , consisting of 620 procedures and 4,177 language instructions overall, where each procedure is a sequence of instructions paired with the corresponding board state. Later, we also use the Text2CAD Khan et al. (2024) benchmark.
blocks.zh: 数据。 我们使用原始的六角星数据集Lachmy等人(2022年),由620个程序和4,177个语言指令总体组成,其中每个程序是一个指令序列,与相应的板态对齐. 后来,我们还采用了Text2CAD Khan等人(2024年)的基准.

blocks.en: Task. The Hexagons task is defined as follows. The input is a procedure describing a complex image, composed of multiple instructions. The procedure is processed all at once. 2 2 2 Appendix B compares this setup with the original step-by-step benchmark protocol of Lachmy et al. (2022) . We evaluated models under one of three execution scenarios: (i) Direct Prediction , which outputs a list of (row, col, color) tuples specifying the tiles to paint; (ii) Unrestricted Python Generation , which outputs Python code implementing get_tiles() to return the same tuples; and finally, (iii) DSL-based Code Generation , where the input includes the DSL API documentation and the output is code using the DSL, whose execution yields the target.
blocks.zh: 任务 六角星任务的定义如下. 输入是一个描述复杂图像的程序,由多个指令组成. 程序一并处理。 2 2 附录 B将这一设置与Lachmy等人最初(2022年)的分步骤基准协议进行比较. 我们在三种执行方案之一下评价了模型:(一) 直接预测,它输出一个列表(row, col, color) 的拖轮,指定要画的瓦片;(二) 无限制的 Python 世代,它输出执行 get_tiles() 的 Python 代码,以返回同样的拖轮;以及(三) 基于DSL 的代码生成,其中输入包括DSL API文档,输出是使用DSL的代码,其执行产生目标.

blocks.en: Models. We evaluate both proprietary and open-weight models, both low and high reasoning (thinking) settings: GPT-5.1 and Gemini-3-Pro (high/low), Gemini-3.1-Pro (high), Qwen3-30B-A3B (a reasoning model) ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , and Gemma-3-27B-IT ( Team, 2025 ) . The open models are served locally via vLLM on 2 A100 GPUs.
blocks.zh: 模特儿们 我们既评价专有模型,也评价开放量模型,包括低推理(思考)设置:GPT-5.1和双子座-3-Pro(高/低),双子座3.1-Pro(高),Qune3-30B-A3B(推理模型)(杨等人,2025年),以及Gemma-3-27B-IT(Team,2025年). 在2台A100 GPU上通过vLLM在当地服务开放型号.

blocks.en: Inference. All models are decoded with temperature 0 0 and a maximum output length of 15K tokens. Generated programs are executed in an isolated environment with a 60-sec. timeout and up to 3 retries conditioned on the resulting exception message.

blocks.en: Metrics. Following Lachmy et al. (2022) , we report F1 and exact match on the final board state. In the all-at-once setting, board-level F1 equals action-level F1 in Lachmy et al. (2022) . Table 1 reports mean ± \pm standard deviation over three execution runs. Table 3 reports mean ± \pm standard deviation across three independently induced libraries, each evaluated over three execution runs.
blocks.zh: 度量衡. 继Lachmy等人(2022年)之后,我们报告F1和最终棋盘状态的精确匹配. 在全场设置中,棋盘级F1等于Lachmy等人(2022年)的动作级F1. 表1报告是指在三次执行中出现的标准偏差。 表3报告指三个独立引领的图书馆的±\pm标准偏差,每个图书馆评价超过三个执行运行。

blocks.en: 5 Does Explicit Abstraction Help?
blocks.zh: 5 明确抽象帮助吗?

blocks.en:
Table 1 presents execution results across all models and strategies. Overall in terms of F1, Unrestricted Python Generation improves over Direct Prediction in five of six settings, while exact match remains broadly similar overall. This suggests that generating an executable program is often more effective than predicting tiles directly.
Then, DSL-based Code Generation pushes the results further, essentially closing the gap with the human skyline of F1=82.06 reported by Lachmy et al. (2022) . It achieves the highest F1 across all six models and the highest exact match in five of six, indicating that explicit, executable abstractions improve grounding beyond code execution alone.
We further see that weaker models benefit more from the DSL-based strategy: relative to Direct Prediction , the three weakest models improve F1 by 13.3–25.8%, compared with 8.6–14.5% for the three strongest.
blocks.zh:
表1列出所有模式和战略的执行结果。 总的来说,在F1,无限制的Python生成中,在6个设置中,有5个设置比直接预测有所改善,而确切的匹配总体上仍然大体相似. 这表明生成可执行程序往往比直接预测瓷砖更有效.
随后,基于DSL的代码生成将结果进一步推向前进,基本上缩小了与Lachmy等人(2022年)报告的F1=82.06的人类天际线的差距. 它在所有6种模式中实现了最高的F1,在6种模式中实现了最高的精确匹配,表明明确,可执行的抽象可以改善基础,超越代码执行本身.
我们进一步看到,较弱的模型从基于DSL的战略中获益更大:相对于直接预测,三种最弱的模型将F1提高了13.3–25.8%,而三种最强的模型则提高了8.6–14.5%。

blocks.en: Lachmy et al. (2022) showed that model performance degrades as abstraction increases. We now ask the respective question, whether the DSL is especially helpful in the harder, more abstract, scenarios. Figure 3 suggests that it is indeed the case. At Level 0 the DSL method performs on par with the other strategies for every model, but at Levels 2–3 it leads by up to 0.21 F1, essentially showing that the more abstract the instruction, the more the DSL helps.
blocks.zh: Lachmy等人(2022年)表明,模型性能随着抽象度的增加而退化. 我们现在要问的是,在更困难、更抽象的情况下,DSL是否特别有用。 图3显示情况确实如此。 在 0 级, DSL 方法与其他策略相同, 用于每个模型, 但在 2–3 级, 最多 0. 21 F1 , 基本上显示指令越抽象, DSL 帮助就越多 。

blocks.en: Figure 3: F1 as a function of abstraction level under the 3 strategies.
blocks.zh: 图3:F1作为3战略下抽象水平的一个函数.

blocks.en:
We next ask how models use the DSL.
Figure 4 reports
the breadth of DSL usage (i.e., the number of unique DSL methods invoked, out of the 41 available) and the volume of DSL usage (i.e., the total number of DSL method calls issued), each plotted against board F1.
In terms of breadth , stronger models use more of the DSL; Gemini 3 Pro (High) and GPT-5.1 (High) invoke 23–24 unique methods, versus 19–20 for Gemma 3 and Qwen 3 (Spearman ρ = + 0.80 \rho=+0.80 with F1). Volume runs the other way, and tracks F1 almost perfectly (Spearman ρ = − 1.00 \rho=-1.00 ): weaker models issue substantially more DSL calls. This suggests that weaker models rely on fewer methods and call them more repetitively, while stronger models spread their calls across a wider slice of the DSL and invoke it more sparingly overall, hinting at more targeted abstraction selection.
All in all, the DSL helps all models, but the gain scales with the model’s ability to exploit the structure it provides.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来问模型是如何使用DSL的.
图4
DSL使用量的广度(即41种可用方法中引用的独特DSL方法的数量)和DSL使用量(即发出的DSL方法调用总量),每一种都针对棋盘F1进行绘图.
在宽度方面,更强的模型更多地使用DSL;双子座3 Pro(High)和GPT-5.1(High)引用了23–24的独特方法,而Gemma 3和Quen 3则引用了19–20(Spearman à = + 0.80\rho=+0.80与F1). 音量运行于另一方向,跟踪F1几乎完美(Spearman $ = − 1.00\rho=-1.00):较弱的模型发出大量DSL调用. 这表明,较弱的模型依赖较少的方法,并更重复地称呼它们,而较强的模型则将它们的呼声分散在DSL的更大片段,并更节制地全面引用它,暗示了更有针对性的抽象选择.
总之,DSL帮助了所有的模型,但增益的尺度与模型利用它所提供的结构的能力.

blocks.en: Finally, we test whether the models’ errors stem from lacking visual feedback. Showing the board after each instruction does not help: when adding the visual signal, for HexaGen -based generation the difference is negligible, for direct tile prediction performance degrades markedly (Appendix A ).

blocks.en: 6 Does This Hold Beyond Hexagons ?
blocks.zh: 6 这是否超过六边形?

blocks.en: To test whether our results generalize beyond the Hexagons task, we turn to Text2CAD ( Khan et al., 2024 ) with its CadQuery annotations ( Xie and Ju, 2025 ) , where each object is paired with design instructions at four levels of abstraction, from expert to abstract . Taking CadQuery as the foundation library, we hand-curate a small DSL of eight recurring abstractions following the design principles of Section 3 . We follow the evaluation setup of Khan et al. (2024) and simplify by using a single protocol across all four abstraction levels: a VLM judge compares renders of the DSL and direct programs pairwise, with position randomized, and returns a preference or declares the pair indistinguishable. Programs that fail to execute count as losses, and pairs where both fail are dropped. Full details are provided in Appendix C .
blocks.zh: 为了检验我们的结果是否超越六角星任务,我们转而使用Text2CAD(Khan等人, 2024年)及其CadQuery注释(Xie and Ju, 2025年),其中每个对象在四个抽象层次上与设计指令配对,从专家到抽象. 以CadQuery为基金会图书馆, 我们按照第3节的设计原则, 我们遵循Khan等人(2024年)的评价设置,并使用一个涵盖所有四个抽象层次的单一协议来简化:一个VLM判断器比较DSL和直接程序成对的制式,位置随机化,返回偏好或宣布对称不可区分. 无法执行的程序算作损失, 以及两个失败都丢弃的对数 。 详情见附录C。

blocks.en: Table 2: Text2CAD pairwise VLM-judge preferences between DSL and direct CadQuery generation, across abstraction levels and two models (single seed, 885 examples/level/model). Percentages are over pairs for which a judgment was reached.
blocks.zh: 表2:Text2CAD在DSL和直接的CadQuery生成之间对齐的VLM判断偏好,跨抽象层次和两个模型(单种子,885例/级别/模型). 百分比是已作出判决的对数。

blocks.en: Table 2 shows that the DSL is preferred in seven of eight model–level comparisons, the exception being Gemini-3.1-Pro at the beginner level, where the two are effectively tied (17.1% vs. 17.5%). Some of this gain is a matter of reliability: the DSL lowers the execution-failure rate for both models, most sharply at the expert level, from 51.3% to 35.1% for Qwen3-30B-A3B-Thinking and from 21.7% to 13.4% for Gemini-3.1-Pro.
blocks.zh: 表2显示,在8个模型-级别比较中的7个中,DSL是首选的,例外是初学者级的双子座-3.1-Pro,两者实际上捆绑在一起(17.1%对17.5%). 其中一些收益是一个可靠性问题:DSL将两种型号的执行失败率降低,在专家一级最显著的是,Qune3-30B-A3B-Thinking从51.3%降至35.1%,双子座3.1-Pro从21.7%降至13.4%。

blocks.en: 7 Can LLMs Induce DSLs Themselves?
blocks.zh: 7 LLMs 能够诱导 DSLs 他们自己吗?

blocks.en: Table 3: Results for induced DSL variants and the human-curated DSL. We report F1 and board-level exact match (EM) as mean ± \pm standard deviation across three independently induced libraries; each library is evaluated over three execution runs. Gemini rows use Gemini 3.1 Pro and are not comparable to Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 表3:诱导DSL变体和人测度DSL的结果。 我们报告F1和棋盘级的精确匹配(EM)是三个独立引导的库的平均值±\pm标准偏差;每个库通过三次执行运行来评价. 双子座列使用双子座3.1 Pro,与表1不相上下.

blocks.en: Observing the substantial gains using HexaGen , our human-curated DSL, we ask whether LLMs can induce useful and effective DSLs themselves.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到使用HexaGen这一经人验证的DSL所取得的巨大收益,我们询问LLMS本身是否能够诱导有用和有效的DSL.

blocks.en:
We design an experiment where each evaluated model induces its own DSL.
Each induction variant is run 3 times per model, producing 3 independently induced libraries. Each library is evaluated over 3 execution runs. For proprietary models, we use only the high reasoning setting.
blocks.zh:
我们设计了一个实验,每个被评估的模型 都会诱导自己的DSL。
每个诱导变体每个模型运行3次,产生3个独立诱导的图书馆. 对每个图书馆的评价超过3次。 对于专有模型,我们只使用高推理设置.

blocks.en: As mentioned in Section 4 , the induction pipeline has three stages: abstraction discovery , method implementation , and documentation authoring , which we detail here in turn.
blocks.zh: 如第4节所述,诱导管道有三个阶段:抽象发现、方法实施和文献编写,我们依次详述。

blocks.en:
In the discovery stage, we vary how the instruction corpus is presented to the model: (1) flat , which seeks and proposes abstractions for all instructions in a single prompt; (2) arbitrary batching , which partitions the corpus into fixed-size batches, analyzes each independently, and then deduplicates and merges the resulting proposals; and (3) semantic batching , which replaces arbitrary batches with sets of similar instructions, obtained by k k -means clustering over BGE-M3 instruction embeddings ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , targeting batches of 100 instructions for both batched variants.
Grouping related examples before prompting resembles the clustered-sampling variant of Grand et al. (2024, Appendix C.2) .
blocks.zh:
在发现阶段,我们不同如何向模型呈现指令集:(1)平面,它以单一的即时方式寻求和提出所有指令的抽象;(2)任意批量,将指令集分为固定的批量,分别进行分析,然后将由此产生的建议合并;(3)语义批量,用类似指令集取代任意批量,由k-意为BGE-M3指令嵌入(Chen等人,2025年),针对两个批量变体的100批指令。
在提示前分组相关实例类似于Grand等人(2024年,附录C.2)的集群抽样变体。

blocks.en: In the implementation stage , given the proposed method signatures, the model receives the foundation-library source and doc and generates complete implementations, including docstrings and executable examples. Methods that fail to compile or fail their doctest examples are removed. Validation and deduplication are standard in LLM tool-creation pipelines ( Yuan et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 在执行阶段,鉴于拟议的方法签名,该模型得到基础文献来源和Doc,并产生完整的执行,包括docstrings和可执行的例子。 无法编译或未能校验实例的方法将被删除。 在LLM工具生成管道中验证和调试是标准(Yuan等人,2024年).

blocks.en:
In the documentation stage , the model produces the final documentation, which serves as the only interface provided for inference. It is written for LLMs rather than human readability, favoring clarity and unambiguous information.
This follows LILO’s AutoDoc procedure ( Grand et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
在文件编制阶段,该模型将产生最后文件,作为提供推断的唯一接口。 报告是为法学硕士编写的,而不是为人读取,有利于清晰和明确的信息。
这遵循了LILO的AutoDoc程序(Grand等人,2024年)。

blocks.en: Table 3 shows that the human-curated HexaGen achieves the highest F1 and exact match in all four model settings, outperforming the best induced variant by 3--10 F1 points. Still, some induced DSLs perform strongly in individual runs: all-at-once induction with GPT-5.1 (High) reaches 0.816 F1 / 0.452 EM. The main limitation is thus consistency rather than capability, as the same induction settings that produce strong libraries also produce runs falling below the minimal baseline. For Gemini 3.1 Pro the pattern is stronger: no induced variant beats the minimal API they extend. 3 3 3 Our induced libraries fare better than the negative result of Grand et al. (2024) , though the comparison is loose: we induce Python functions over a foundation API, a materially easier target than abstractions in a novel formalism (§ 8 ).
blocks.zh: 表3显示,人造六金在所有四个模型设置中都实现了最高的F1和精确的匹配,表现优于最佳诱导变体3-10 F1分. 尽管如此,一些诱导的DSL在单个运行中表现强劲:GPT-5.1(High)的一次性全能诱导达到0.816 F1/0.452 EM. 因此,主要的限制因素是一致性,而不是能力,因为产生强大图书馆的相同的上岗环境也低于最低基线。 对于双子座3.1 Pro来说,模式更强:没有诱导变体比它们延伸的最小API强. 3 3 我们引领的图书馆票价优于Grand等人(2024年)的负面结果,不过比较松散:我们在基础API上诱导Python函数,这个目标在实质上比新形式主义中的抽象主义容易(§8).

blocks.en: Beyond execution quality, the strategies differ in how many methods they induce: batched discovery yields substantially more methods than flat analysis, though library size does not correlate with downstream performance (Appendix D ).
blocks.zh: 除了执行质量外,这些策略在产生多少方法方面有所不同:批量发现产生的方法比平面分析要多得多,尽管库的大小与下游的性能无关(附录D)。

blocks.en: Finally, we manually inspect two induced libraries to learn about the type of errors they produce. This shows how a single foundational error in the library’s design can make an induced library perform worse than no library at all. Both come from the same setup, GPT-5.1 (High) with the flat induction variant, yet Run A reaches 0.816 board-F1 while Run B reaches 0.700, below both non-DSL baselines for this model (0.765 Tiles, 0.757 Unrestricted Python). They cover about the same abstractions and differ in one fundamental choice: Run B falsely treats the board as a rectangular lattice. Seven of its ten methods rest on that assumption, and all seven run without failing while producing wrong tiles. Run A gets the geometry right, and its remaining distance to HexaGen is of a different kind: it has no compositional layer, no first-class Shape with set operations, spatial queries, or anchor-based copy (Table 4 ).
blocks.zh: 最后,我们手动检查两个诱导的库,以了解它们产生的错误类型。 这表明在图书馆设计上一个单一的基础错误会使得一个诱导的图书馆的表现比根本没有一个图书馆更糟糕. 两者都来自相同的设置,GPT-5.1(High)带有扁平诱导变体,然而运行A达到0.816板-F1而运行B达到0.700,低于该模型的两个非DSL基线(0.765 Tiles,0.757无限制Python). 它们涵盖同样的抽象,在一个基本选择上有所不同: 跑乙错将棋盘当作长方形的纹饰. 其十种方法中的七种基于这一假设,所有七种方法都在生产错误的瓷砖的同时运行而不失败. 运行 A 获得几何的正确性,其与HexaGen的剩余距离也不同:它没有组成层,没有具有设定操作,空间查询,或基于锚的复制的一等形状(表4).

blocks.en: 8 Related Work
blocks.zh: 8 相关工作

blocks.en: Grounded instruction following maps natural language to executable actions in situated environments, spanning navigation ( MacMahon et al., 2006 ; Chen and Mooney, 2011 ; Anderson et al., 2018 ) , robotic manipulation ( Tellex et al., 2011 ; Ahn et al., 2022 ) , and collaborative construction ( MacMahon et al., 2006 ; Artzi and Zettlemoyer, 2013 ) . Across these settings, performance degrades as instructions become more abstract ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ; Ruis et al., 2020 ; Wu et al., 2021 ; Ahn et al., 2022 ) . In Hexagons ( Lachmy et al., 2022 ) , where instructions are annotated by abstraction level, this trend is measured directly. We take this gap as a starting point and ask whether an executable target language that makes abstractions explicit can help close it.
blocks.zh: 根据地图的自然语言进行基础教学,以便在位置环境,跨越导航(MacMahon等人,2006年;Chen and Mouney,2011年;Anderson等人,2018年),机器人操纵(Tellex等人,2011年;Ahn等人,2022年),以及合作建设(MacMahon等人,2006年;Artzi and Zettlemoyer,2013年)。 在所有这些环境中,性能随着指令的抽象化而退化(Shridhar等人,2020年;Ruis等人,2020年;Wu等人,2021年;Ahn等人,2022年)。 在Hexagons(Lachmy等人,2022年)中,指令以抽象水平附加说明,这个趋势直接衡量. 我们将此差距作为起点,并询问一个可执行的目标语言,使抽象化变得明确,是否能够帮助关闭它.

blocks.en: A growing body of work treats grounded reasoning as program synthesis: instead of predicting outputs directly, the model generates executable code. This paradigm has been effective in mathematical reasoning ( Gao et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2023 , e.g.,) , visual question answering ( Gupta and Kembhavi, 2022 ; Suris et al., 2023 ) , and embodied control ( Liang et al., 2022 ; Singh et al., 2022 ; Ahn et al., 2022 ) . Code generation is a natural fit for abstract instructions because programming languages already provide mechanisms such as variables, loops, and functions. However, when models generate in a general-purpose language or over low-level action sets, they must still recover task-specific abstractions on their own. Our comparison of direct inference, unrestricted Python, and DSL-based generation shows that making these abstractions explicit and executable is itself a major factor in execution quality.
blocks.zh: 越来越多的工作把基于推理视为程序合成:模型不是直接预测输出,而是生成可执行代码. 这种范式在数学推理(Gao等人,2023年;Chen等人,2023年,例如),视觉问答(Gupta and Kembhavi,2022年;Suris等人,2023年),以及体现控制(Liang等人,2022年;Singh等人,2022年;Ahn等人,2022年)方面一直有效. 由于编程语言已经提供了变量,环路,函数等机制,代码生成自然适合抽象指令. 然而,当模型以通用语言产生或超过低级动作集时,它们仍必须自行恢复特定任务抽象. 我们对直接推论,不受限制的Python和基于DSL的生成的比较表明,使这些抽象内容明确和可执行性本身就是执行质量的主要因素.

blocks.en: Domain-specific abstractions for code generation have often taken the form of external DSLs that restrict the target language, both in classical program synthesis and semantic parsing ( Gulwani, 2011 ; Berant et al., 2013 ) and in recent LLM systems that translate natural language into formal domain-specific targets ( Wong et al., 2023 ) . HexaGen , by contrast, is an internal DSL: the model writes unrestricted Python, while the DSL supplies callable abstractions such as named shapes, spatial queries, and composable transformations. In this respect, it is closer to API-augmented generation ( Liang et al., 2022 ; Singh et al., 2022 ) , though those systems expose fixed low-level action primitives rather than abstractions aligned with the level at which people give instructions.
blocks.zh: 用于代码生成的域特异性抽象往往采取外部DSL限制目标语言的形式,无论是在古典程序合成和语义解析(Gulwani,2011年;Berant等人,2013年)还是在最近将自然语言翻译为正式域特异性目标的LLM系统中(Wong等人,2023年). HexaGen是一个内部DSL:模型写作不受限制的Python,而DSL则提供命名形状,空间查询,和可共生变等可调抽象. 在这方面,它更接近API增强的一代(Liang等人,2022年;Singh等人,2022年),尽管这些系统暴露了固定的低级动作原始,而不是与人们给出指示的水平一致的抽象。

blocks.en: The question of whether models can discover reusable abstractions connects to prior work on library learning and tool induction, which differs from ours in the signal abstractions are found in: recurring code rather than recurring language. In the external DSL setting, DreamCoder ( Ellis et al., 2021 ) compresses solved programs, keeping an abstraction when it shortens the corpus by more than it costs to define; LAPS ( Wong et al., 2021 ) adds word alignments to that objective, but only to score candidates compression already extracted; and LILO ( Grand et al., 2024 ) adds an LLM searcher and documentation, reporting abstractions proposed by an LLM prompted with programs as an appendix negative result only. On the internal side, LATM ( Cai et al., 2024 ) and CREATOR ( Qian et al., 2023 ) build per-task tools rather than a library, while Voyager ( Wang et al., 2023 ) admits skills by execution success during open-ended play. We instead induce a library from instructions paired with board states, with no solved programs to compress: what recurs across the instructions is the only signal available, and the abstractions we seek are those a speaker compresses into a phrase — not the fragments that recur across solutions.
blocks.zh: 模型能否发现可重复使用的抽象物的问题与之前的图书馆学习和工具诱导工作相关联,这在信号抽象物中与我们不同,见于: 重复代码而不是重复语言. 在外部的DSL设置中,DreamCoder(Ellis等人,2021年)压缩解开程序,在缩短程序时保持一个抽象,比定义成本还要高;LAPS(Wong等人,2021年)为这一目标增加了字词对齐,但只是为了给已经提取出来的候选人压缩分数;LILO(Grand等人,2024年)增加了一个LLM搜索器和文档,报告一个LLM推动的抽象,只作为附录负面结果. 在内部方面,LATM(Cai等人,2024年)和CREATOR(Qian等人,2023年)建造了每个任务工具而不是一个库,而Voyager(Wang等人,2023年)则通过在开放式游戏中执行成功的方式承认技能. 我们从与板状状态配对的指令中诱导一个库,没有解开的程序来压缩:在指令中重复的是唯一可用的信号,我们所寻求的抽象是那些扬声器压缩成一个短语——而不是跨解决方案重复的碎片.

blocks.en: 9 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 9 结论

blocks.en: The core challenge in grounded instruction following is mapping abstract, underspecified language to concrete, executable actions. We show that a DSL is a useful device for making task-relevant abstractions explicit. Concretely, we show on Hexagons that generating executable code with HexaGen , a human-curated DSL, substantially outperforms both direct prediction and unrestricted code generation — with higher gains at higher abstraction levels. However, current LLMs still do not reliably induce such DSLs with similar efficacy on their own right. Model-authored DSLs in our settings occasionally approach the human-curated baseline but remain far more unstable, with no discovery strategy consistently resolving this instability. Enabling models to automatically construct robust, transparent, task-specific abstraction layers therefore remains an intriguing open challenge. To promote research progress on this matter, we release our code, data, evaluation pipeline, and all DSLs, encouraging the community to advance work on executable abstraction and DSL induction.
blocks.zh: 下述有根据的指令的核心挑战是将抽象、不够具体的语言用于具体、可执行的行动。 我们显示,DSL是一个有用的设备,可以使与任务相关的抽象内容变得明确. 具体地说,我们用HexaGen(人测度的DSL)生成可执行代码的Hexagons来显示,其效果大大超过直接预测和不受限制的代码生成——在更高的抽象水平上收益更高。 然而,目前的有限责任公司仍然无法可靠地自行产生具有类似效力的这类DSL。 在我们的环境下,模型授权的DSL偶尔会接近人造基线,但仍然更加不稳定,没有一贯的发现策略解决这种不稳定. 因此,使模型能够自动构建强健、透明、针对具体任务的抽象层仍然是一个令人感兴趣的公开挑战。 为了推动这方面的研究进展,我们发布了我们的代码,数据,评价管道,以及所有的DSL,鼓励社区推进可执行抽象和DSL诱导的工作.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Our evaluation covers Hexagons and Text2CAD . The two differ in domain and output space, but broader coverage across additional testbeds would strengthen the generality of our claims. The Text2CAD replication is also deliberately lightweight: its DSL comprises eight functions, against the 41 of HexaGen . It therefore establishes that the effect transfers, and does not measure how large that effect can be in a second domain.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价涵盖六边形和Text2CAD。 两者在域和产出空间上有所不同,但扩大对更多试验床的涵盖范围将加强我们要求的普遍性。 Text2CAD的复制也是故意轻量级的:其DSL由8个功能组成,与HexeGen的41个功能相对. 因此,它规定效应的转让,而不衡量这种效应在第二个领域可能有多大。

blocks.en: All three induction strategies share one design: the model authors a DSL from a fixed pool of examples and never runs the result. Run B suggests this may matter — its rectangular-lattice assumption breaks seven of ten methods and would surface on the first execution — though a single case does not establish how much an iterative variant would recover.
blocks.zh: 所有三种上岗策略都有一个共同的设计:模型从固定的示例库中生成一个DSL,并且从未运行结果. 运行B表明,这可能很重要——它的长方形-纬度假设打破了十种方法中的七种,并且会在第一次执行时浮出水面——尽管一个案例不能确定一个迭代变体会恢复多少.

blocks.en: Two directions follow from these results. The first is multi-turn interaction, which our setting does not consider. The second is DSL induction itself. Our results establish that a good abstraction layer helps and that current models do not reliably produce one, which leaves the induction problem open.
blocks.zh: 这些结果有两个方向。 第一个是多回合互动,我们的环境没有考虑。 第二个是DSL感应本身. 我们的结果表明,一个良好的抽象层有帮助,而目前的模型不能可靠地产生一个,这就使得诱导性问题没有解决。

blocks.en: Figure 5 tracks how many candidate methods survive each stage of induction — proposal, deduplication, and validation — under the three induction strategies. For the three stronger models, both batched strategies produce substantially more validated methods than flat analysis, suggesting that a single pass over the full instruction corpus is too coarse for the model to attend to recurring patterns. Gemma 3 is the least consistent, with method counts varying greatly across strategies. A larger library is not in itself better, however: many candidates are removed during deduplication or validation, and only a subset is ever called downstream. Method count is therefore best read as a diagnostic of the induction process rather than as a quality measure, with the execution results in Table 3 providing the relevant comparison.

blocks.en: HexaGen API specification. ⬇ # ==== HEXAGEN API SPEC ==== # One entity per line; two-space indentation shows containment. # Extra ’Notes:’ lines clarify hidden behaviour. Import : from hexagen import Game , Tile , Shape , Line , Circle , Triangle Constant : WIDTH = 18 Constant : HEIGHT = 10 Constant : COLORS = [ ’white’ , ’black’ , ’yellow’ , ’green’ , ’red’ , ’blue’ , ’purple’ , ’orange’ ] # These are the hexagon board directions, most methods use these directions, some of them also extends the list to more directions. Constant : DIRECTIONS = [ ’up’ , ’down’ , ’up_right’ , ’down_left’ , ’up_left’ , ’down_right’ ] # ------ Class : Game Method : __init__ ( width : int = WIDTH , height : int = HEIGHT ) Method : start ( width : int = WIDTH , height : int = HEIGHT ) -> Game Method : __enter__ () -> Game Method : __exit__ ( exc_type , exc , tb ) -> bool Method : record_step ( step_name : str ) # Notes: closes previous step snapshot Method : get_record ( step_names : str | list [ str ]) -> Shape # tiles drawn in named step(s) Method : plot ( gold_boards : list [ int ] | list [ list [ int ]] | None = None , multiple : bool = False , file_name : str | None = None , show : bool = True ) -> Figure # ------ Class : Shape # Base class for collections of tiles Method : __init__ ( tiles : list [ Tile ] | Tile | Shape , from_linds : bool = False , from_hexagons : bool = False , game : Game | None = None ) Notes : duplicate tiles removed ; single - tile => auto - up - casts to Tile . # -- Painting helpers (ALL mutate active board **and** return the new Shape) -- Method : draw ( color : str ) -> Shape # auto-paints Notes : draw () overwrites the tile ’s previous color. To find where two shapes overlap, compute the intersection BEFORE drawing: overlap = shape_a * shape_b (or shape_a.intersection(shape_b)). Method: copy_paste(shift_direction:str | None = None, # auto-paints spacing:int = 0, reference_shape:Shape | None = None, source:Tile | None = None, destination:Tile | None = None, shift:_Vec | None = None) -> Shape Notes: Returns a NEW Shape at the destination. To chain multiple copies, call copy_paste on the RETURNED shape. For repeated copies in one direction, use grid() instead. Param options: shift_direction in {’ left ’,’ right ’} OR DIRECTIONS OR None Method: reflect(axis_line:Line | None = None, column:int | None = None, # auto-paints axis_direction:str | None = None, tile_on_axis:Tile | None = None) -> Shape Param options: axis_direction in {’ horizontal ’,’ vertical ’} OR DIRECTIONS Method: grid(shift_direction:str, spacing:int, num_copies:int | None = None) -> Shape # auto-paints shift_direction in {’ left ’,’ right ’} OR DIRECTIONS OR None; num_copies=None => ’ fill board ’. Method: rotate(center_tile:Tile, angle:int) -> Shape # auto-paints angle must be multiple of 60. Method: recolor(color_map:dict[str,str]) -> Shape # auto-paints # -- Geometric queries ------------------------------------------------- Method: get(criterion:str) -> Shape # the method returns a new Shape object that has the criterion geometric relation to the original shape or the tiles with selected colors Param options: {’ outside ’,’ inside ’,’ above ’,’ below ’,’ top ’,’ bottom ’, ’ corners ’,’ endpoints ’} OR DIRECTIONS OR COLORS Method: neighbors(criterion:str = ’ all ’) -> Shape Param options: {’ all ’,’ right ’,’ left ’,’ above ’,’ below ’,’ outside ’,’ inside ’,’ white ’} OR DIRECTIONS Method: boundary(criterion:str = ’ all ’) -> Shape # criterion in {’ all ’,’ outer ’,’ inner ’} # The method returns the boundary tiles belonging to the shape itself, without including any tiles outside the shape. Method: edge(direction:str) -> Shape # direction in {’ left ’,’ right ’,’ top ’,’ bottom ’} OR DIRECTIONS Method: extreme(direction:str) -> Shape # direction in DIRECTIONS Method: is_empty() -> bool Method: overlaps(other:Shape) -> bool Method: intersection(other:Shape) -> Shape # same as shape_a * shape_b Method: center() -> Tile # center of mass (rounded) # -- Set operators -------------------------------------------------- Operator: shape_a + shape_b -> Shape # union Operator: shape_a * shape_b -> Shape # intersection Operator: shape_a - shape_b -> Shape # difference # -- Utilities (static) ------------------------------------------------ Static: get_entire_board(game:Game | None = None) -> Shape Static: get_board_perimeter(game:Game | None = None) -> Shape Static: get_color(color:str | {’ all ’,’ any ’}, game:Game | None = None) -> Shape Static: get_column(column:int, game:Game | None = None) -> Shape Static: polygon(vertices:Shape | list[Tile] | Tile, *extra_vertices:Tile) -> Shape # CRITICAL: polygon() connects consecutive vertices with Line(), so every # consecutive vertex pair must be colinear on a hex axis. If vertices are # not hex-colinear, draw each edge as a separate Line(start, direction=..., length=...). # ------ Class: Tile (inherits Shape) Method: __init__(row:int, column:int, game:Game | None = None) Notes: negative indices wrap from opposite edge. Method: neighbor(direction:str) -> Tile # direction in DIRECTIONS only -- ’ left ’/’ right ’ are NOT valid here Method: on_board() -> bool Property: color:str Property: column:int Property: row:int Property: offset:tuple[int,int] # (row,col) 1-based # ------ Class: Line (inherits Shape) # Note creating a line from two tiles is only valid if the tiles lie on a straight hex direction Method: __init__(start_tile:Tile, end_tile:Tile | None = None, direction:str | None = None, length:int | None = None, end_tiles:Shape | None = None, include_start_tile:bool = True, include_end_tile:bool = True) Param options: direction in DIRECTIONS only (’ left ’/’ right ’ NOT valid here); if end_tile supplied, direction/length ignored. Notes: If direction is given but length is omitted (None), the line extends to the board edge. Only specify length when you need a shorter line. # CRITICAL: Line(start, end) raises an error if the two tiles are not colinear # on a hex axis (i.e. do NOT share the same q, r, or s cube coordinate). # Prefer Line(start, direction=..., length=...) for reliable line creation. Method: parallel(shift_direction:str, spacing:int) -> Line # shift_direction in {’ left ’,’ right ’} OR DIRECTIONS OR None Method: draw(color:str) -> Line # inherited auto-paints # ------ Class: Circle (inherits Shape) # The created Circle has a hollow center Method: __init__(center_tile:Tile, radius:int = 1) Method: draw(color:str) -> Circle # inherited auto-paints # ------ Class: Triangle (inherits Shape) # The created triangle has only sides with the center beign hollow Method: __init__(start_tile:Tile, point:str, start_tile_type:str, side_length:int = 2) Param options: point in {’ left ’,’ right ’}; start_tile_type in {’ side ’,’ top ’,’ bottom ’}. # CRITICAL: side_length must be >= 2. For a single-tile annotation, use Tile.draw() instead. Method: draw(color:str) -> Triangle # inherited auto-paints’

blocks.en: Stage 4: Documentation spec generation. ⬇ Write the API spec section for class ‘{ class_name }‘{ domain_context }. CLASS SOURCE CODE : ... EXAMPLE INSTRUCTIONS this library handles : { instructions_text } OUTPUT FORMAT -- produce ONLY a Class section like this : Class : ClassName # optional brief role comment # -- Category Name ------------------------ # group related methods Method : method_name ( param1 : type , param2 : type ) -> ReturnType # brief inline note Param options : param1 in { ’val1’ , ’val2’ } OR SOME_CONSTANT Notes : One sentence max . Only when inline comment isn ’t enough. # CRITICAL: warning about non-obvious constraint or common mistake ... RULES: 1. Document ONLY public methods (no _ prefix). Skip __repr__, __str__, __hash__, __eq__. 2. Be CONCISE: prefer inline ‘#‘ comments over multi-line Notes. 3. GROUP methods by function (e.g. ’ Drawing / painting ’, ’ Navigation ’). Use ‘# --‘ headers. 4. Mark methods that modify state with ‘# auto-paints‘ or ‘# mutates‘ inline. 5. Add ‘# CRITICAL:‘ warnings for methods that are easy to misuse. 6. Use compact set notation for param options.’
